versions.changelog:
UK Health & Safety Risk Assessment Generator – Initial Release

- Generate HSE-compliant UK risk assessments from plain English descriptions for multiple scenarios.
- Supports Quick Assessment (immediate output) and Detailed Assessment (guided questions for higher-risk work).
- Automatically identifies and generates: General Workplace, COSHH, Fire, Manual Handling, DSE, Lone Working, Working at Height, Construction Method Statement, and New & Expectant Mothers assessments.
- Includes legal references, required format, and specific content per assessment type.
- Every report concludes with a legal disclaimer and review guidance.
